description_en: Queries the list of routing policies for a VPC firewall for a transit router
description_zh: 获取TR防火墙路由策略列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-tr-firewall-v2-route-policy-list --lang zh --firewall-id vfw-tr-d5ba592ac6c84aff0000 --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --policy-id policy-7b66257c14e141fb0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTrFirewallV2RoutePolicyList
